aliases: At the source, along the path, at the worker

one_line_answer.text: Workplace hazards can be controlled so they don't injure you or make you sick.

cites.quote: While your workplace may have many hazards, they can be controlled so that they
don't injure you or make you sick.

keywords.bn: মেশিন যেন চালু না হয় তার ব্যবস্থা

bangla_explanation: Hazard থাকলেই ক্ষতি হবে এমন নয়; ঠিক control দিলে ক্ষতি আটকানো যায়।
সবচেয়ে ভালো control হলো source-এ, তারপর path-এ, আর শেষ উপায় worker-এর কাছে, যেমন PPE।
যেকোনো control-কে তিনটি কাজ করতে হবে: hazard control, নতুন hazards তৈরি না করা, আর আরামে কাজ করতে দেওয়া।

example.en: In a welding shop, local ventilation removes fumes. Welding screens protect co-workers. Both work along the path.
example.bn: ওয়েল্ডিং শপে local ventilation আর welding screen দুটোই along the path control।

list_answer.title: Strategies for controlling hazards
list_answer.title_bn: Hazard নিয়ন্ত্রণের কৌশল: কোথায় control করা হয়

items.text: At the source: redesign processes, install guards, isolate, replace hazardous substances.

cites.quote: At the Source
Redesigning work processes
Installing guards and enclosures around moving parts
Isolating dangerous processes
Replacing hazardous substances with less hazardous ones

items.text: Along the path: use local ventilation and welding screens.

cites.quote: Along the Path
Using local ventilation systems to remove fumes
Putting up welding screens to protect co-workers

items.text: At the worker: rules and procedures, limiting how long, and personal protective equipment.

cites.quote: At the Worker
Creating rules and procedures for how people work around hazards
Limiting how long workers are around dangerous materials
Providing personal protective equipment like safety glasses

items_bn: উৎসে (at the source) — hazard যেখান থেকে আসে সেখানেই থামানো: processes redesign, guards বসানো, isolate করা বা hazardous substances বদলানো।
পথে (along the path) — hazard যেন worker পর্যন্ত না পৌঁছায়, যেমন local ventilation ও welding screens।
কর্মীর কাছে (at the worker) — rules ও procedures, কতক্ষণ কাজ করবে তা সীমিত রাখা, আর personal protective equipment; এটাই শেষ উপায়।

traps.text: The best control is at the source. The last choice is at the worker.

cites.quote: The best way to prevent injury is to use controls right at the source of the hazard.
The last choice is to use hazard controls at the worker.

traps.text: Every control must control the hazard, create no new hazards, and allow comfortable work.

cites.quote: 1. Control the hazard 2. Not create any new hazards 3. Allow you to do your job comfortably

traps.text: Like the hierarchy of controls, personal protective equipment (PPE) is the last choice.

cites.quote: This principle is referred to as the hierarchy of controls
Providing personal protective equipment like safety glasses
The last choice
Personal protective equipment is always considered a control of the last resort.

traps.text: Lockout makes sure machinery won't start during set-up or clean-up.

cites.quote: Lockout procedures make sure machinery or equipment won't start and injure a worker during set-up, clean-up

cites.quote: Lockout procedures make sure machinery or equipment won't start and injure a worker during set-up, clean-up or similar work.

cites.quote: Ventilation systems remove harmful vapours from the air.

cites.quote: Substitution involves replacing a dangerous chemical or material with a safer one.

rows.text: Safe work procedures, such as washing hands, help prevent the spread of germs.

cites.quote: Safe work procedures such as washing hands can help prevent the spread of germs.

rows.text: Redesigning workstations or the way work is done helps control ergonomic hazards.

cites.quote: Redesigning workstations or the way work is done can help control ergonomic hazards.

rows.text: Violence prevention, anti-bullying and stress reduction programs help lower stress.

cites.quote: Violence prevention, anti-bullying and stress reduction programs will help lower stress.

short.prompt: Where can hazards be controlled? Give examples.
short.modelAnswer:
Hazards can be controlled in three places:
1. At the source (best): redesign processes, guards, isolation, safer substances.
2. Along the path: local ventilation, welding screens.
3. At the worker (last choice): rules and procedures, limiting time near hazards, PPE.
